ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is titled “Central Plains Urban Agglomeration,” and marks cities such as Luoyang, Jiyuan, Jiaozuo, Xinxiang, Kaifeng, Zhengzhou, Xuchang, Luohe, and Pingdingshan; Zhengzhou is located in the middle of the area shown, with multiple railway lines passing around it and extending toward Luoyang, Kaifeng, Xinxiang, Xuchang, and other directions, showing that its transportation connections are the most concentrated. method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中标有中原城市群内多个城市，郑州处在区域中心，交通线从郑州附近向洛阳、开封、新乡、许昌等方向联系。再读题干要求判断“图示整个区域被哪个城市的服务范围覆盖”。根据中心地服务范围规律，交通枢纽和区域核心城市的服务范围最大，因此判定覆盖整个图示区域的是郑州。
